description: Mitigations for thermal exposure — hot contact, hot environment, cold contact, cold environment. Sub-mechanism determines which mitigations apply.

mitigations.name: insulation_guarding
mitigations.description: Insulation or guards on hot surfaces/pipes preventing accidental contact. Surface temperature kept below 60°C (EN 563 burn threshold). Passive engineered control.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.05. Failure: insulation removed for maintenance and not replaced, damaged, missing sections.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: EN 563: surface below 60°C prevents burns from momentary contact. Insulation reduces surface temperature to safe levels.

mitigations.name: thermal_ppe
mitigations.description: Heat-resistant gloves (EN 407), cold-insulating gloves (EN 511), thermal clothing. Protects against contact burns and frostbite.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.12. Failure: not worn, wrong rating for temperature, gloves wet (reduces insulation), damaged.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: EN 407 rates gloves for contact heat, convective heat, radiant heat, and molten metal resistance. When rated correctly, prevents skin contact damage.

mitigations.name: wbgt_monitoring
mitigations.description: Wet Bulb Globe Temperature monitoring with NIOSH-recommended work-rest cycles. Limits heat exposure duration based on metabolic rate and environmental conditions.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.15. Failure: WBGT not measured, work-rest cycles not enforced (production pressure), individual variation in heat tolerance not accounted for.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: NIOSH criteria: work-rest cycles keep core temperature below 38°C for most workers. Effectiveness depends on compliance with rest periods.

mitigations.name: hydration_cooling
mitigations.description: Water provision, cooling vests, shade structures, acclimatisation programme. Supports thermoregulation but doesn't eliminate the heat exposure.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.15. Failure: water not available/accessible, cooling equipment not worn (uncomfortable), acclimatisation not completed.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Supplementary control — reduces heat strain but cannot prevent heat illness in extreme conditions. Most effective as part of a WBGT-managed programme.

mitigations.name: cold_weather_clothing
mitigations.description: Appropriate cold-weather layering, windproof outer layer, insulated footwear, heated shelter access. Prevents hypothermia during outdoor cold-weather work.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.10. Failure: inadequate clothing for conditions, clothing wet (loses 90% insulation), no shelter access for warming, lone worker unable to self-rescue if incapacitated.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Adequate clothing maintains core temperature in most cold conditions. Wet clothing is the critical failure — wind + wet dramatically accelerates heat loss.

mitigations.name: pfd_immersion_suit
mitigations.description: Personal flotation device and immersion suit for work over/near cold water. Prevents drowning and extends cold water survival time. Maritime/offshore requirement.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.10. Failure: not worn (common on deck), suit damaged/leaking, incorrect size.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: PFD keeps head above water (prevents drowning). Immersion suit extends survival from ~30 min (5°C unprotected) to several hours. Buys time for rescue.

mitigations.name: emergency_cooling
mitigations.description: Immediate cooling of burns (running water 20 min), active cooling for heat stroke (ice bath, cold IV fluids), trained first aiders on site.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.15. Failure: first aider not available, cooling facilities not accessible, delayed recognition of heat stroke.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Burns: 20 min cold running water within 3 hours of burn reduces severity by ~1 AIS grade. Heat stroke: rapid cooling to core <39°C within 30 min dramatically improves survival.
